title: WeatherBetter
tagline: a funny, nounish weather betting product to save your mood! It allows users to bet on the weather of a specific place and date by utilizing the technology of Worldcoin, Base, Chainlink, Unlimit andNounsDao

prizes.placement: Best Use Case of Unlimit Crypto
prizes.title: Best Use Case of Unlimit Crypto

description: Our project is a decentralized weather betting Dapp,  which allows users to bet on the weather of a specific place and date. A possible use case is that for instance, a user will travel to Sydney in a week, and he does not want the rain to ruin his trip. So he places a bet like 100 USDC on the rainy weather on that day, if it's not rainy on that day, he would lose his bet but gain a pleasant weather. But if the weather ruins his trip,  he could get some money instead to save his mood!
how_its_made:
Our project relies on the following technology:
(1) Chainlink's CCIP technology and weather data feeds. CCIP technology enables a cross-chain token bridge between the Base chain and Ethereum, making the user experience smoother. Weather data feeds help make a state change on a blockchain to trigger the automated asset allocation among the winners.
(2) Base Sepolia and Avalanche Fuji. They provide the blockchain to record the on-chain transactions and EVM to run the smart contracts. They ensure our users' funds are handled securely and automatically.
(3) Nouns vibe and art. NounsDAO's brand and vibe are a perfect match with our funny, nounish product style, which makes our product more interesting and attractive to users.
(4) Worldcoin proof-of-humanity. Our project aims to become anti-bots and anti-symbil attacks, which allows our project to provide real user values for the public.
(5) Unlimit Wallet.  Our Dapp seamlessly integrates with Unlimit’s on/off ramps to make our Dapp accessible to web2 users as well.
